name: guest.view
description: The page a share link opens to a guest with no sign-in: an idea's brief (and the shoot it is on), or a shoot's call sheet; only what it says, not how the team planned it; and the comments.
sql:
select case l.kind
  when 'idea' then (
    select jsonb_build_object('kind', 'idea', 'access', jsonb_build_object('can', l.can, 'brandId', l.brand_id),
      'idea', jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'format', i.format, 'hook', i.hook, 'angle', i.angle,
        'feature', i.feature, 'inspiration', i.inspiration, 'shots', i.shots),
      'shoot', (select jsonb_build_object('day', s.day, 'start', s.start, 'end', s."end", 'place', s.place)
        from brandbase.shoots s where i.id = any (s.idea_ids) order by s.day, s.id limit 1),
      'comments', brandbase.thread('idea', i.id))
    from brandbase.ideas i where i.id = l.target_id)
  else (
    select jsonb_build_object('kind', 'shoot', 'access', jsonb_build_object('can', l.can, 'brandId', l.brand_id),
      'shoot', jsonb_build_object('id', s.id, 'title', s.title, 'day', s.day, 'start', s.start, 'end', s."end",
        'place', s.place,
        'crew', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', c.name, 'role', c.role) order by c.position)
          from brandbase.crew c where c.shoot_id = s.id), '[]'),
        'ideas', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'format', i.format, 'hook', i.hook,
          'inspiration', i.inspiration, 'shots', i.shots) order by array_position(s.idea_ids, i.id))
          from brandbase.ideas i where i.id = any (s.idea_ids)), '[]')),
      'comments', brandbase.thread('shoot', s.id))
    from brandbase.shoots s where s.id = l.target_id)
  end as result
from brandbase.share_links l where l.token = :token
